text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: TIC-KE-ZO! TIC-KE-ZO!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The ecstatic chants of the new champion's
name ring out toward the
track.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hah! You hearing this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I expected no less. That was an
outstanding Derby!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Aaah... The Derby! I won the... I won the...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Geez, you beat me fair and square.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It was the only possible path. Yours was
truly the road to victory.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taishin! Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That was the best race... The best Derby
ever! And it was ours!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But it won't go this way next time. In the
Kikuka Sho, it'll be my turn
to win.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, our goal isn't just the Derby. There's
still plenty of races to go.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Totally! And we'll run them all together!
Let's go for it! To what's
beyond the
Derby!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The cheers for Winning Ticket from
outside can be heard through the
whole
length of the runners' tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That's quite a chant. You can hear it across
the entire racetrack.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I think Tickezo's enthusiasm may have
spread to all her fans.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah, Traineeer!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I did it! I won the Derby! It feels like I'm
dreaming!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Winning Ticket. Hehe,
are you sure you didn't want
to take in
more of that applause?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hehe, sure, but there's interviews to do.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And, you know, this won't be the last I
hear it. There's gonna be tons
of chances
in the future!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yes. She fulfilled her dream of conquering
the Derby, but this isn't
the end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Because her story will go on.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's make it happen together!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right, Ms. Tazuna! Let's get to those
interviews! I gotta make up
for missing the
prerace press conference!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
And now, the racer who won the Derby in
spectacular fashion—please
welcome
Winning Ticket!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Heehee, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
First, hearing the audience chant your
name after the race—how did it
make you
feel?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I gave my all to make this the best Derby
ever, so I was really happy
that everyone
watching picked up on it!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
You raced against your BNW rivals today.
What was the key to your
victory?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I trained a whole lot, for sure, but what
really motivated me...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Was my dream of winning the Derby, and
the promise I made with my
bestie rivals.
That, and...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I really wanted to make my trainer a Derby
trainer for being so
supportive all this
time!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
One last thing. A message from the Derby
winner!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
My name's Winning Ticket, and I'm the
winner of the greatest Derby
ever!
